opening.text: I've got yellowing in my eyes and skin, which I first noticed about three weeks ago. My stools have been light and my urine is darker than usual, plus I've been itching. I had a blood transfusion during my C-section 20 years ago, and I took a brief trip to Mexico about two months ago. I also drink wine.
